hypothesis: Explicit ball-valve standard-execution wording can be deterministically expanded into standard-bore catalog vocabulary to improve candidate recall without changing selection semantics.
why_now: A scored public failure returns a human-rejected full-bore item despite documented standard-bore catalog evidence. This is a bounded vocabulary mismatch.
expected_effect: Hybrid retrieval gains one guarded alternate query; original retrieval, reranker input, output text, fusion, and selection remain unchanged.
expected_metric_gain: +3.3 pp public hard-pass plausible; blind gain uncertain but credible.
lesson_from_history: Cycles 1, 2, 5, and 8 found selection-adjacent changes harmful or neutral. Additive canonicalization was accepted in cycles 3–4; broad shorthand expansion and index enrichment were rejected, so this is a distinct, narrow query-time experiment.
plan_summary: Created and strict-validated proposal, spec, design, and implementation-only tasks in openspec/changes/cycle-09-standard-bore-retrieval-canonicalization/. No product code changed.
